data.body:
# Lux GPT-Live Copilot V1

User result: Run `npm run copilot`, speak a creative instruction, hear a short
confirmation after the Responses backend changes the current visual through MCP,
then give a relative follow-up without restarting the conversation.

Scope: trusted local Node CLI; gpt-live-1; managed Responses delegation; existing
stdio MCP adapter; default microphone and speaker. No Electron/web UI, screenshots,
vision, MIDI, persistent memory, new Lux controls, or second control API.

Implementation and acceptance:
- [ ] Connect an MCP SDK client to scripts/studio-mcp.mjs; list tools and read real status before voice startup.
- [ ] Stream PCM16 microphone and speaker audio continuously through official LiveWS.
- [ ] Derive backend function schemas from MCP tools; serialize calls and return exact errors/results.
- [ ] Verify multiple spoken turns, a speed change, and a relative follow-up on the running visual.
- [ ] Test configuration, tool continuation/error propagation, and bounded cleanup.
- [ ] Independent review and relevant checks; document commands and evidence limitations.

Files: tools/live-copilot/{index,audio,live,mcp,prompt}.ts, focused tests, package.json,
pnpm-lock.yaml, and tools/live-copilot/README.md. Reuse MCP SDK, studio-session profile
rules, guard schemas exposed by tools, and Node's existing TypeScript execution.

Backend uses managed Responses delegation to retain conversation context. A small
function bridge maps discovered schemas and calls the existing stdio server; the
hosted Responses MCP transport cannot reach local stdio. Do not call Studio internals.
Use documented response.event/output_item.done and explicit function output/continue
messages. Keep listening during backend execution. Do not retry uncertain mutations.

Official references inspected 2026-09-15:
- https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/voice-websockets?api=live
- https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/live-delegation
- https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/live-conversations
- https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/tools-connectors-mcp
- https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-live-1

events.body: Implementation and24 focused tests delivered in main checkout. Real voice/visual acceptance needs a reachable matching lux-studio MCP entry and permitted Codex tools; current tracer entry fetch fails and noninteractive tool approval is refused. Preserve safeguards. See tools/live-copilot/README.md for setup and smoke test.

Implemented in main checkout as uncommitted reviewed changes. Browser Start/Stop voice, client delegation to subscription-only local Codex, fixed auth/provider settings, key sanitization, existing MCP config, no paid fallback. npm run test:copilot:24 pass. npm run typecheck:pass. Real Codex0.154.0 ChatGPT login verified. Actual local Codex read-only status attempted, MCP approval refused under noninteractive policy; accurately returned failure. Main npm run copilot -- --check-mcp refuses startup: configured tracer MCP fetch failed. Final MCP wrapper independently passed isolated Studio status (12 tools), test PID38036 profile test-b07f1e8d-7411-4e4e-a52c-39a22a7190af then cleaned. Independent Sol review findings on Stop finalization and mutation evidence fixed/reviewed. Actual browser screenshot docs/implementation/live-copilot-browser.png; external services disabled during UI review. No live voice or visual-change acceptance claimed. .env.local preserved and gitignored. Local setup required: pair saved lux-studio entry with running Lux and resolve intended tool approvals in Codex; no safeguard or global login changes made.

User reiterated full authorization and asked to continue without permission interruptions. Remaining execution prompts came from enforced Windows sandbox/normal-user dependency and credential-store access, not missing user intent. Continued work and completed main-checkout tests. Do not request redundant conceptual authorization; use required tool escalation only where the host enforces it.

User scope correction: browser microphone with Start/Stop controls replaces native CLI audio. Voice remains GPT-Live API billed. Delegation uses local Codex saved ChatGPT authentication and existing Lux MCP configuration, forced invocation settings, stripped voice credentials, no paid fallback. CLI 0.154.0 reports ChatGPT login. Focused mocked tests19 and typecheck pass; real-service checks pending.
